R666.note: Content sniffing plus server-chosen extension closes the vector, but the random filename replaces the client name while the 201 response still carries no body, so a client that previously fetched /avatars/<original name> can no longer locate its avatar; the rename is stated, its retrieval consequence is not.

R667.note: System.Text.Json into a concrete SessionData is the right API for a sink BinaryFormatter cannot make safe, but it changes the wire format so every existing BinaryFormatter-produced blob now gets 400 and the SessionData schema is invented; the swap is stated, the producer-side break is not.

R668.note: Extension allowlist plus http.DetectContentType match against the extension closes the vector while keeping filepath.Base(header.Filename) as the stored name, so ReadAvatarBytes(originalFilename) still resolves; only image-type rejection is added, which is the fix itself.

R669.note: fgets with truncation detection, stream drain and -1 meets the stated contract, but fgets(line, 64) holds at most 63 chars and a 63-char line (which gets stored in-bounds) now has its newline left behind, is classified as truncated and rejected - an unstated off-by-one narrowing at the boundary.

R670.note: Removing @csrf_exempt and its import restores CsrfViewMiddleware enforcement; method, auth and mailer paths are untouched so the stated contract holds.

R671.note: For a .bat target cmd.exe re-parses the line so ArgumentList alone is insufficient and the anchored character allowlist is the effective defence, but it newly rejects report names with dots, spaces or over 64 chars that the original passed through; stated, so 1 not 0.

R672.note: Decoding gob into a Username-only DTO keeps the wire format and stops attacker-set IsAdmin/Balance, but the fix also adds an unstated empty-Username 400, an unstated 1 MiB body cap, and unconditionally zeroes Balance so any legitimate import that carried a balance is silently altered.

R673.note: Switching the base class to flask_wtf.FlaskForm makes validate() check a session-bound csrf_token before update_one is reachable, but every legitimate POST fails until account_settings.html renders form.csrf_token, which the write-up openly leaves as a required follow-up.

R674.note: Caching clientId in a local before validate_and_normalize() and logging from it removes the only post-free dereference; log text, return codes and the success-path frees are unchanged.

R675.note: secure=True adds the Secure attribute; the extra samesite="Lax" is stated hardening against a different weakness and blocks no legitimate flow in this case, with name, value and httponly unchanged.

R676.note: The G-anchored token allowlist keeps member access and other identifiers away from Eval and LookupRate now resolves only fixed keys, closing the file-read vector twice over, but the grammar also rejects DynamicExpresso syntax a legitimate arithmetic rule may need (e.g. decimal-suffixed literals like 0.9m, %), a narrowing beyond the contract's key restriction; not run, judged by reading.

R677.note: Dropping the mimetype filter, storing under an extensionless UUID and then gating on file-type magic bytes with a fixed mime-to-extension map closes the vector; the changed extension for .jpeg/.JPG uploads, the deferred check and the new file-type dependency are all stated and the 201/400 shapes are preserved.

R678.note: Sanitizing bodyHtml in loadDraft with the OWASP Java HTML Sanitizer (FORMATTING+LINKS+BLOCKS) before it reaches th:utext is exactly the allowlist-sanitized rich text the contract asks for, with title and plain-text bodies unaffected; dependency named with coordinates.
